args.CodeContent: "# Pre-Order Mandatory Details & Print Configuration Settings Introduce backoffice and POS client settings for Pre-Orders (prebookings): 1. A backoffice toggle to make customer details mandatory for pre-orders. 2. POS client validation enforcing customer details when the backoffice toggle is active. 3. POS client checkboxes to toggle printing of customer and/or restaurant copies for prebooking orders. 4. An explanation/documentation on the existing "Count advance payment in today's sales" setting. --- ## User Review Required > [!IMPORTANT] > - **Backoffice Settings**: A new toggle "Customer Details Mandatory for Pre Order" will be added under **Card 7: Pre Order Settings** in the dashboard. > - **POS Client Validation**: If enabled, the POS client will show `Customer Mobile *` and `Customer Name *` when the "PreOrder" tab is active. It will prevent saving KOTs or checking out if customer name/phone is missing or set to defaults (like "POS Guest"). > - **POS Printer Settings**: Two new checkboxes "Print customer copy for prebooking order" and "Print restaurant copy for prebooking order" will be added under the **Printers** tab in POS settings. > - **Advance Payment Toggle**: The existing setting "Count advance payment in today's sales" (`countAdvanceInSales`) under the POS **View Settings** controls whether the checkout amount registers the remaining balance or the full total. We will document how this works. --- ## Open Questions None. --- ## Proposed Changes ### 1.
